workload_snippets.cpu_sieve:
import json,time
t0=time.perf_counter()
n=5000000
sieve=bytearray(b"\x01")*(n+1)
sieve[0:2]=b"\x00\x00"
limit=int(n**0.5)+1
for p in range(2,limit):
 if sieve[p]:
  sieve[p*p:n+1:p]=b"\x00"*(((n-p*p)//p)+1)
primes=[i for i,v in enumerate(sieve) if v]
count=len(primes)
total=sum(primes)
t1=time.perf_counter()
print("BENCH_RESULT:"+json.dumps({"workload":"cpu_sieve","n":n,"in_python_ms":round((t1-t0)*1000.0,3),"prime_count":count,"checksum":total}))

import json,math,time
t0=time.perf_counter()
acc=0.0
for i in range(1,1500001):
 acc+=math.sin(i)*math.cos(i)+1.0/(i+1.0)
t1=time.perf_counter()
print("BENCH_RESULT:"+json.dumps({"workload":"cpu_math","iters":1500000,"in_python_ms":round((t1-t0)*1000.0,3),"checksum":round(acc,6)}))
workload_snippets.mem_json:
import json,time
t0=time.perf_counter()
data=[{"id":i,"group":f"g{i%64}","name":f"item_{i:06d}","values":[i,i*2,(i*3)%997,round(i*0.125,3)],"meta":{"active":(i%2==0),"tag":f"t{i%16}"}} for i in range(50000)]
raw=json.dumps(data)
parsed=json.loads(raw)
totals={}
for row in parsed:
 g=row["group"]
 totals[g]=totals.get(g,0)+row["values"][2]
checksum=sum(totals.values())
t1=time.perf_counter()
print("BENCH_RESULT:"+json.dumps({"workload":"mem_json","records":len(parsed),"json_bytes":len(raw),"in_python_ms":round((t1-t0)*1000.0,3),"checksum":checksum}))
